user.title: Posti package tracking
user.description: The coming and recently delivered packages of your OmaPosti account. Posti package tracking logs in like the OmaPosti app, with your user name and password.

data_description.username: The email address you log in to OmaPosti with. The sensor is named after it.
data_description.password: Saved in Home Assistant, for logging in again when the saved login expires.
data_description.language: Language of the package event descriptions.
data_description.prioritize_undelivered: When there are more packages than the maximum, undelivered ones are listed before delivered ones.
data_description.max_shipments: How many packages the sensor lists.
data_description.stale_shipment_day_limit: Counted from the package's latest event. Some packages stay in delivery for good.
data_description.completed_shipment_day_shown: Counted from the delivery. Packages returned to the sender count as delivered.
